method: Country-specific piecewise anchor histories using institutional continuity, dimension-specific participation/development facts and temporally gated elite competition evidence.
evidence_rules: Croatia before 1992 is explicit current-territory-within-Yugoslavia context, not independent-state fiction.
Poland preserves the 1951 governance discontinuity and does not backcast modern youth funding.
China's large youth system raises access/development separately from men's elite competition; the 2025 zero-Top100 fact constrains competition quality.
Current Swiss participation and infrastructure are not backcast.
No held-out validation ranking is used to tune authored ratings.
